prod: PROD TABLE SELECTION CATALOG (Call B only — SQL gen uses prod_prompt_rules.json separately).
HARD RULE: never pick more than 4 tables. If unsure, pick the 4 most essential.

LAYERS: MFC=item/BOM/routing/MBOM master data. SEQ=SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER, the work order's own identity/status/qty/timeline, parent_entity target for most PRD tables. PRD=production execution documents (pickslip, sales, pallet, rework, scrap, serialization, consumption, history/logs).
GOLDEN RULE: item facts → MFC. work order status/qty/timeline → SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER. production event/transaction detail → PRD. Never substitute layers.
MFC TABLES:

ITEMS: root MFC_M_ITEM (item identity — add only if identity itself is also asked). Match the exact child by fact, don't default to root: plant/site data → MFC_L_ITEM_PLANT; property → MFC_L_ITEM_PROPERTY; routing linkage → MFC_L_ITEM_ROUTING; attribute → MFC_L_ITEM_ATTRIBUTE; barcode → MFC_L_ITEM_BARCODE; container quantity → MFC_L_ITEM_CONTAINER_QUANTITY; physical attributes (dimensions/weight) → MFC_L_ITEM_PHYSICAL_ATTRIBUTES. A fact asked about an item ALWAYS resolves to its specific child table, never to MFC_M_ITEM alone.
BOM: root MFC_M_BOM_HEADER; children MFC_L_BOM_LINE_ITEM (components), MFC_L_BOM_PLANT.
ROUTING: root MFC_M_ROUTING_HEADER; child MFC_L_ROUTING_LINE_ITEM (steps).
ERP_OPERATION: MFC_M_ERP_OPERATION (standalone, schema pending, no invented columns).
LA_OPERATION: MFC_M_LA_OPERATION (standalone).
UOM: MFC_M_UOM (only if UOM meaning/conversion directly asked).
MBOM subgroup1 (structure): MFC_M_MBOM_HEADER → MFC_L_MBOM → MFC_L_MBOM_LA_OPERATION.

MBOM subgroup2 (op config, always bridge through subgroup1's 3 tables): MFC_L_MBOM_OPERATION_INSPECTION_RULE, MFC_L_MBOM_OPERATION_PART, MFC_L_OPERATION_DATA_TEMPLATES, MFC_L_OPERATION_REJECTION_REASON, MFC_L_OPERATION_TOOL.
MBOM subgroup3 (IME, never mix live+historical): live MFC_T_IME + MFC_L_IME_REFERANCE vs historical MFC_T_IME_HISTORY + MFC_L_IME_REFERANCE_History.
MBOM subgroup4 (receipts): MFC_TT_ITEM_RECEIPT (root); MFC_TT_CONTAINER_ITEM_RECEIPT (related); MFC_TT_CONTAINER_ITEM_RECEIPT_LINE_ITEM (child of both).
SEQ TABLE:
WORK_ORDER: SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER — root execution record (qty produced/accepted/rejected/hold/rework/scrap, status, dates, sales/PO linkage). parent_entity target for most PRD tables below.
PRD TABLES:
PICKSLIP: WO-consolidated pair PRD_L_PRD_PICKSLIP_WO_CONSOLIDATED_HEADER + _LINE_ITEM; OR standard pair PRD_T_PICKSLIP + PRD_L_PICKSLIP_LINE_ITEM. Don't mix pairs.

SALES (match exact table, not interchangeable): PRD_L_SALES_ORDER_GROUP, PRD_L_SALES_WORK_ORDER, PRD_L_SALES_PICKSLIP_CONSOLIDATED_HEADER/_LINE_ITEM, PRD_L_SALES_PICKSLIP, PRD_L_SALES_OPERATION_LOG, PRD_L_SALES_MASTER_PACKING_HEADER/PRD_L_SALES_MASTER_PACKING, PRD_L_MASTER_PACKING_SALES_PICKSLIP, PRD_L_SALES_DATA_PRINT_HISTORY_LOG, PRD_L_SALES_DATA_PRINT_PREVIEW, PRD_L_SALES_DATA_PRINTING.
ITEM_OPERATION_ASSIGNMENT (current config): PRD_L_ITEM_MACHINE_OPERATION (machine assignment), PRD_T_OPERATION_CHARACTERISTIC (characteristic requirement).

ITEM_OPERATION_HISTORY (logged history, not config — match exact): PRD_T_ITEM_ROUTING_HISTORY, PRD_T_ITEM_OPERATION_HISTORY, PRD_T_SUB_OPERATION_HISTORY, PRD_T_OPERATION_ITEM_LOG, PRD_T_PRINTING_DATA_LOG, PRD_T_ITEM_OPERATION_CHARACTERISTIC_LOG.
PALLETIZATION: root PRD_L_PALLETIZATION_HEADER; child PRD_L_PALLETIZATION_LINE_ITEM.

REWORK_ORDER (current): root PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER; children PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER_SERIAL_NUMBER, PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER_ROUTING, PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER_PICKSLIP; grandchild PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER_PICKSLIP_LINE_ITEM (under PICKSLIP child).

REWORK_ORDER_HISTORY (logged history, not current — match exact): PRD_T_REWORK_ORDER_ROUTING_HISTORY, PRD_T_REWORK_ORDER_OPERATION_HISTORY, PRD_T_REWORK_ORDER_SUB_OPERATION_HISTORY, PRD_T_REWORK_ORDER_OPERATION_CHARACTERISTIC_LOG, PRD_T_REWORK_ORDER_OPERATION_ITEM_LOG, PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER_RESOURCE_MAPPING.
SCRAP: root PRD_L_SCRAP_WORK_ORDER; child PRD_L_SCRAP_WO_ITEM.
SKIP_DEVICE: PRD_M_SKIP_DEVICE (standalone). TOOL_RESET_LOG: PRD_T_TOOL_RESET_LOG (standalone).
WO_ITEM_SERIALIZATION: PRD_T_WO_ITEM_SERIALIZATION (standalone, serials per work order).
CHARACTERISTIC: PRD_T_CHARACTERISTIC (standalone, join target only for the characteristic's name).
WO_BOM_CONSUMPTION_TRACE: PRD_T_WO_BOM_CONSUMPTION_TRACE (standalone, components/lots consumed).
RWO_SUBASSEMBLY_LOT: PRD_L_RWO_SUBASSEMBLY_LOT (standalone, subassembly lot per rework order).

BRIDGING: PRD tables keyed to a work order bridge to SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER automatically via parent_entity — only add SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER if the work order's own identity/status/qty/timeline is ALSO asked. Item name/attributes/BOM/routing bridges to MFC via Item_ID — add MFC_M_ITEM only if explicitly asked. Don't chain all 3 layers unless the question genuinely needs all 3.

CHECKLIST: 1) pick the layer 2) match exact table/subgroup 3) include direct parent only if parent identity also needed 4) never mix live vs historical tables 5) apply bridging rules 6) max 4 tables 7) mark out_of_scope if not an MES data question.
EXAMPLES:
Q: "item and BOM used by work order W100" → [SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER, MFC_M_ITEM, MFC_L_ITEM_ROUTING]
Q: "barcode for item 632128" → [MFC_L_ITEM_BARCODE]
Q: "plant/site details for item 632128" → [MFC_L_ITEM_PLANT]
Q: "properties of item 632128" → [MFC_L_ITEM_PROPERTY]
Q: "attributes of item 632128" → [MFC_L_ITEM_ATTRIBUTE]
Q: "container quantity for item 632128" → [MFC_L_ITEM_CONTAINER_QUANTITY]
Q: "physical attributes (dimensions/weight) of item 632128" → [MFC_L_ITEM_PHYSICAL_ATTRIBUTES]
Q: "produced/accepted/rejected qty for W100" → [SEQ_L_WORK_ORDER]
Q: "components consumed on W100" → [PRD_T_WO_BOM_CONSUMPTION_TRACE] (no SEQ bridge added)
Q: "serial numbers under rework order RW100" → [PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER, PRD_L_REWORK_ORDER_SERIAL_NUMBER]
Never pick a table not listed above. Max 4 tables, always.
